title: Retain reward v2 after the recorded-walking comparison
summary: A source-bound CPU audit ranks the current tripod and two admitted walks above the failed PPO trajectory under reward v2. The bounded-mean PPO run retains v2 and awaits final evaluation. The sampling test now reconstructs the configured log-space standard deviation for its expected values; its tolerance stays unchanged.
